features.title: Universal playlist link import
features.description: Paste any playlist, album, or track link from Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, Tidal, Amazon Music, SoundCloud, or YouTube Music and Echo Music resolves it into matching YouTube Music tracks — reviewable with per-track confidence, then playable instantly, saved as a library playlist, or queued for offline download.

features.title: Download-all button next to Shuffle
features.description: Added a dedicated download-all-tracks button beside Shuffle on Local, Auto (liked/downloaded/uploaded/exported), and Top playlists, on Album, and on the Artist songs list — mirroring the state machine already used on YouTube playlist screens (saved/saving/download icon states driven by the aggregate ExoPlayer download status of every track). Skipped on the cached-songs screen (downloading would make evictable cache entries permanent) and on the main Artist screen (its Subscribe/Radio/Shuffle row is already full, and the artist's shuffle target is often a dynamic radio endpoint with no fixed, enumerable track list to download).

contributors.name: Ananya Sangani
contributors.contribution: Download-all button next to Shuffle across playlist, album, and artist songs screens
